info.name: Tamagotchi
info.description:
A scenario of the Tamagotchi service through the Gateway, with real User Management accounts and tokens. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner: every request feeds the next.

Setup finds the active package in Registry and registers and logs in two fresh users. Each registration publishes user.package_joined.v1, and Tamagotchi mints the package starter from it, so the creatures are polled for rather than minted: no service is allowed tamagotchi:mint.

Needs the shared stack with the broker, a seeded Registry and tamagotchi_fixture_package_id identifying the configured Dragon Tamers fixture (FEED adds 20 hunger and 5 XP). XP awards, engagements and holder grants are service-only operations called through the broker, so they are not here. Holder and collection scenarios establish co-ownership through a real public Battle. Supply tamagotchi_secondary_package_id for a distinct configured starter package; the two users join it and fight with real lineups. The setup is repeated after the first holder deletion, so both deletion routes run independently. No internal service grant is exposed. Care expectations follow the seeded Dragon Tamers rules: feed adds 20 hunger, capped at 100, and 5 xp.

UUID v7 is generated in the collection pre-request script because Postman's {{$guid}} is v4 and the contract rejects it.
